# Prior-version SQLite compatibility fixture

`local_state_v6.sqlite3` is synthetic data generated by the actual v6 implementation
at commit `9cd3a826843789e479f95c5856e033054b50b60c`, not a v7 database with its version
label changed. SHA-256:
`26cdc97aa9696abe1ba5083d5c0320300c4a2c769245c05fee46f5d0cac7909f` (741,376 bytes).

It contains two canonical observations, generation 2, acknowledgement 1, visibility
epoch 7 and a 524,288-byte synthetic metadata value. It contains no user data.
Two independent producer runs yielded byte-identical artifacts; integrity check passed.
The exact baseline accessor accepted this fixture and rejected a current-produced v7
database with `StoreError::SchemaMismatch` during independent review.

To reproduce, create a separate detached worktree at the commit above and apply
`local_state_v6.producer.patch` there. The patch adds test-only producer/accessor code;
it does not modify the baseline product implementation. Then, in that worktree:

```sh
AGENTOBS_V6_FIXTURE_OUTPUT=/absolute/new/private/directory/local_state_v6.sqlite3 \
  cargo test -p agent-observability-local-store \
  review_produce_local_state_v6_fixture -- --ignored --nocapture
```

The destination directory must exist; the producer refuses to overwrite the artifact.
The collector regression copies the fixture into an isolated runtime and exercises
stale-reservation cleanup before admitted migration, including cleanup failure/retry.
It never opens this checked-in fixture for writes or uses the installed runtime.
